quarry.title: Let's Work! Quarry Park Volunteer Clean-Up
quarry.description: Kickoff of the annual Let's Work! Winter volunteer program, removing non-native invasive plants from Quarry Park. Volunteers must be 15 or older to join independently, and ages 10–14 must be accompanied by an adult. Sign-up is through the event link, and registration closes three days before the workday or when full.
